# INSIDE LVMH

> > INSIDE LVMH is a learning platform offering free certificates in partnership with HEC Paris, Harvard, and Bocconi, providing insights into careers, innovation, and sustainability across LVMH's luxury brands.

The platform features over 150,000 learners exploring the luxury industry through educational content, career stories from brands like Louis Vuitton, Guerlain, and Moët Hennessy, and insights on digital transformation, sustainability, and technology at VivaTech. It serves as both a learning resource and a window into career opportunities across LVMH's fashion, hospitality, and beauty houses.

## Key Topics

- LVMH luxury brands
- INSIDE LVMH Certificate program
- HEC Paris, Harvard, Bocconi partnerships
- Career development in luxury
- Digital transformation and VivaTech
- Sustainability initiatives
- Luxury retail strategies
- Tech careers in luxury
- Louis Vuitton, Guerlain, Moët Hennessy
- Generative AI and innovation
- Diversity and inclusion
- Professional networking
- Talent development
- Luxury hospitality (Belmond, Cheval Blanc)
- E-commerce and wholesale

## Certificate Program

- [CERTIFICATE](https://www.insidelvmh.com/certificate): 150,000+ learners earned free INSIDE LVMH Certificate for luxury industry
- [Discover the INSIDE LVMH Certificate](https://www.insidelvmh.com/article/discover-the-inside-lvmh-certificate): INSIDE LVMH Certificate program partnered with HEC Paris, Harvard & Bocconi
